hypotheses.latent_object: F(x, y) = T(x, y), a binary indexed kernel with an S2 action on ordered slots
hypotheses.construction_plan: Start from F at the ordered pair (i, j). The identity operator returns F(i, j) = T(i, j). The slot permutation sigma swaps the two arguments, giving sigma F(i, j) = F(j, i) = T(j, i). The raw expression is the orbit sum (identity + sigma)F evaluated at (i, j).
required_assumptions: T is a binary indexed function
i and j are symbols that can occupy the two argument slots
hypotheses.rationale: F01 observes the same function T with reversed arguments, matching the orbit of a binary kernel under slot permutation.

hypotheses.latent_object: U(A, B) = A + B, the unordered sum of two summands under commutative addition
hypotheses.construction_plan: Bind A to T(i, j) and B to T(j, i). The identity placement gives the raw expression A + B. Permuting the two summands gives B + A, which is identified with A + B by commutativity of addition.
required_assumptions: The top-level addition operation is commutative for the two T-term summands
proof_obligations: [T(j, i) + T(i, j)] - [T(i, j) + T(j, i)] = 0 under commutativity
hypotheses.rationale: F02 and F03 report commutative addition/rewrite structure at the top level; the raw expression is a sum of two terms, so swapping the summands preserves the expression algebraically.
